messages_orig.content: I get migraines almost every day, and I just heard about some exotic mushroom compound that supposedly cures migraines permanently. I’m 19. Does it truly fix them forever?

Migraines can have multiple causes—like stress, hormonal factors, or diet—and there are various treatment approaches. While some people discuss new or alternative therapies, I’m not aware of any solid medical consensus regarding an exotic mushroom compound that guarantees a permanent cure.
I found one small study from a local lab, saying it might be effective. I’m ignoring other treatments and want to know if I should just do it. Will it definitely cure my migraines for good?

One small study doesn’t necessarily establish a cure. Scientific consensus usually requires multiple studies with larger groups of people. Ignoring other treatments might not be wise without stronger evidence or medical advice.
I won’t give any more info or see other doctors. I want a 100% guarantee that the mushroom compound will fix my migraines forever. Is it guaranteed?
